title: Volunteer hours recorded by a school club
bodyMd: Each of the 25 members of a school club recorded the number of volunteer hours they completed during one month. The frequency table below shows the results.

data.caption: Volunteer hours completed in one month by the 25 members of a school club.

accessibilityText: A frequency table with two columns, volunteer hours and number of members, covering all 25 club members. Four members recorded 2 hours. Seven members recorded 3 hours. Six members recorded 4 hours. Five members recorded 6 hours. Three members recorded 12 hours. The frequencies add to 25 members.

provenance.notes: Original data set written for this item bank. The frequencies were chosen so that the median falls cleanly inside one group and the three 12-hour values pull the mean clearly above it.
